title: Ixvet Pox / Colossus of War
summary: Break the controllers' formation to face the Colossus of War and Ixvet Pox.
overview: Break the controllers' formation to face the Colossus of War and Ixvet Pox.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Plan for the constructs to activate when their controllers enter combat.
The poison quest sequence can disrupt the controllers; complete its setup before starting combat if using that route.
Keep a tank ready for the colossus when controller deaths release it.
Stay within the encounter area and finish Ixvet to complete the linked sequence.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
The reviewed source is standard or unversioned; this draft applies to version 0.
The source explicitly marks the post-Ixvet Nihil uprising behavior as incompletely parsed.
